name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2026-07-14, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.58 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
